description: This file defines the KamonCounter class, an implementation of a counter metric using the Kamon metrics library. It provides methods for creating, tagging, incrementing, resetting, and retrieving the counter value, and manages internal Kamon counter instances with specific tags.

classes.name: KamonCounter
classes.description: A thread-safe, immutable implementation of a counter metric based on Kamon, supporting tagging, incrementing, resetting, and retrieval of counter values.

methods.name: newCounter
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new KamonCounter instance with a specified name and optional tags.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Returns a new KamonCounter instance with an additional tag added.

methods.name: tags
methods.description: Returns a new KamonCounter instance with multiple tags merged in.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific tag by key.

methods.name: getTags
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the current tags.

methods.name: increment
methods.description: Increments the counter by a specified number of times.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the counter to zero, if supported.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object, including name and tags.
